title: Space Oddity
summary: Commander Chris Hadfield performs a revised version of David Bowie's Space Oddity, recorded aboard the International Space Station. It was released as a music video in 2013.
why: Commenters recommend it for the sense of wonder and chills it gives, and bring it up in threads about Bowie, space and astronauts.
topic: space oddity cover from the iss

quote.text: It gives me chills every time I listen to it.
